responsibility: Groups baked fallback supplement data under the fallback module, currently exposing the collation supplement dataset used by locale fallback provider implementations.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `fallback/mod.rs` and `data/mod.rs`, which organize broader parts of the crate, and unlike `co_v1/mod.rs`, which contains real payload lookup code, this `mod.rs` is a narrow namespace layer that only exposes the fallback supplement subtree.
